# Superpowers attribution

The local debugging and verification method references are condensed adaptations of Superpowers by Jesse Vincent, Copyright (c) 2025 Jesse Vincent, used under the MIT License retained in LICENSE.

Source commit and exact source hashes are recorded in upstream.json. Local wording makes effort proportional, permits reuse of fresh evidence, preserves user restrictions, and distinguishes static findings from executed checks. No upstream scripts, startup hooks, third-party services, dependencies, subagents, worktree or branch management are included. These are adapted local references, not the complete upstream skills or an endorsement by their authors.
